entities.name: Xarl Angel-Keeper
entities.description: A wizard from Golthonor on Corondor who enslaved the angel Trine with a Horned Halo.

entities.name: Trine
entities.description: A Serra Angel bound and enslaved by Xarl.

entities.name: Skule
entities.description: The wizard who recruited Xarl as spellsquire.

entities.name: Init
entities.description: Xarl's infant half-sister, killed by Xarl after a rat bite.

entities.name: Eskil
entities.description: A descendant of Xarl who became his spellsquire, inherited the House of Xarl and became a Planeswalker.

entities.name: Horned Halo
entities.description: An item that bound Trine to Xarl.

entities.name: House of Xarl
entities.description: The line of descendants Xarl founded.

entities.name: Angel Keep
entities.description: Xarl's castle in the mountains of Wolf's Hackle.

events.summary: Xarl kills his infant half-sister Init and the rabid rat that bit her with an empty wine bottle.
events.quote: Xarl himself killed both Init and the rat with a fatal blow by an empty wine bottle

events.summary: Xarl forces Skule to summon the Serra Angel Trine and binds her with the Horned Halo, starting her 326-year enslavement.
events.quote: This started the 326-year-long enslavement of Trine .

events.summary: Mandek Ironfist grants Xarl a castle, Angel Keep.
events.quote: This castle became known as Angel Keep .

events.summary: Xarl uses Trine's power to rise to great power and has her forget being an angel of Serra.
events.quote: he magically caused Trine to forget her past as an angel of Serra

events.summary: Xarl dies; Trine escapes and is killed by her angelic sisters; Eskil inherits the House and becomes a Planeswalker.
events.quote: Eskil in turn became an immortal Planeswalker

relations.quote: he eventually came into the service of the barbarian Warlord Mandek Ironfist
forced his former mentor Skule to summon the Serra Angel Trine
binding her to him and making her a fallen angel
